title: A biological perspective on evolutionary computation
summary: Miikkulainen and Forrest evaluate how evolutionary computation (EC) diverges from biological evolution. Three structural barriers dominate: (1) typical EC uses small populations and strong selection, whereas biology retains diversity under weaker selection, drift, and neutrality; (2) typical EC uses a nearly direct genotype-to-phenotype map, whereas biology uses developmental and regulatory maps with many-to-one encodings and cryptic variation; (3) biology discovers major organizational transitions (new levels of individuality), whereas EC almost always stays at one organizational level. The paper sits with the longer computational-evolution agenda (Banzhaf et al., Nature Reviews Genetics 2006). Crossing these barriers is not a hyperparameter tweak. Small-N smokes that maximize a fitness function faster are evidence of selection pressure, not of biological-scale evolution. Direct instruction genomes that decode into actions remain a direct G-P map even if the instruction set is rich. Group containers that a researcher tags are not a major transition until a new Darwinian individual appears.
key_claims: Small populations plus strong selection strip the diversity biology uses for open exploration.
Direct genotype-phenotype maps skip development, neutrality, and many-to-one encodings.
Absence of major transitions in individuality is a first-class EC failure mode, not a missing metric.
Computational evolution as an agenda is not satisfied by better GA hyperparameters.
codontrace_has: Spatial eat/survive/reproduce life-loop; capacity that can exceed founders; fitness-proportional and optional QD selection; semantic/instruction genomes; dual-parent sexual recombination as an opt-in analog; Phase D trajectories that measure fitness/behavior change; ClaimGate refusal to relabel those measurements as intelligence.
codontrace_lacks: Biological-scale N; systematically weak selection plus neutrality/drift as the research default; an evolved developmental G-P map; any demonstrated major transition in individuality. Default life_loop_world(seed=7, tick_count=12, population=6) is a digest pin, not a biological population.
next_experiment: Large-N weak-selection campaign with explicit drift/neutrality diagnostics versus the current small-N smoke; keep ClaimGate blocked for intelligence. Do not treat scaling N in a unit test as satisfying Nature MI 2021.

title: Task-switching costs promote the evolution of division of labor and shifts in individuality
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences 109:13686-13691
summary: Goldsby, Dornhaus, Kerr, and Ofria used Avida to ask whether the cost of switching tasks promotes division of labor and a shift in individuality. Treatments imposed a CPU-cycle delay when an organism exported a different task type (low / 25-cycle moderate / 50-cycle high). Each treatment was replicated 50 times. Colonies had to collect a resource quota to replicate. Division of labor was measured with Shannon mutual information (Gorelick et al.). Higher switching costs produced more DoL (Kruskal-Wallis). Coordination mechanisms that evolved included communication, spatial patterning, and task partitioning. Under high costs, individuals often lost the ability to perform required tasks in isolation and required the group context — simultaneous loss of lower-level autonomy and gain of higher-level function, a signature of a major transition. Clonal groups (identical genomes) still differentiated behaviorally; DoL was not assembled from pre-specialized genotypes. This is the experimental standard CodonTrace Genesis must meet before claiming evolved DoL: a cost parameter, a group-replication payoff, a DoL statistic, isolation-vs-group competence, and multi-replicate effect sizes. Assigned role tags and round-robin gates are not that experiment. How to get collective intelligence evidence in this tradition: impose a task-switching cost, measure evolved DoL, test isolation vs group competence, and keep ClaimGate blocked until those results exist.
key_claims: Task-switching costs are a causal driver of evolved division of labor in digital organisms.
High switching costs can make individuals depend on group context (loss of lower-level autonomy).
DoL can evolve among genetically identical group members via flexible behavior plus communication.
Literature-grade evidence needs ~50 replicates, a DoL statistic, and isolation controls — not a single smoke delta.
codontrace_has: Phase H TaskSwitchingCostConfig hook; Phase I evolved preference DoL analog; Phase K run_goldsby_cpu_delay_specialist_campaign (research default 50 replicates, 0/25/50-cycle analog treatments, isolation vs group dual-task hooks). is_goldsby_2012_pnas_experiment stays False.
codontrace_lacks: Avida C++ CPU-delay specialists and colony quota; isolation failure that is evolved autonomy loss rather than missing work instructions or analog delay; the PNAS 2012 experiment itself.
next_experiment: How to get collective intelligence evidence: run the Phase K Goldsby harness at research replicate_count=50; keep ClaimGate blocked; do not label the analog the PNAS paper.

title: Avida messaging, GermlineReplication, and digital germlines (Goldsby/Ofria line)
venue: Avida ORGANISM_MESSAGING / DEME_GROUP / GECCO 2008 germlines; PLOS Biology dirty-work soma (2014)
summary: The Goldsby/Ofria Avida line treats communication and germline/soma architecture as evolvable instructions, not as researcher-assigned tags. Avida ORGANISM_MESSAGING exposes send_message, retrieve_message, broadcast_message, and block_propagation. Those instructions must pay: communication ablation that does not drop group payoff is not evidence that messaging evolved as coordination. GermlineReplication / avida.cfg DEME_GROUP (DEMES_GROUP_REPLICATE, GERMLINE) copies a deme when mean fitness clears a threshold, exporting a germline/propagule — multilevel selection as an experiment, not a rank table. GECCO 2008 digital germlines describe cooperative networks in which soma vs germline eligibility is discovered. Goldsby, Knoester, Kerr, and Ofria (PLOS Biology 2014, dirty-work hypothesis) show somatic cells evolving to handle costly tasks while germlines sequester reproduction. CodonTrace Genesis Phase E implements a messaging *buffer* and role *gates*; Phase F records deme payoff, ranking, and DoL metrics with communication_ablation_status=not_run and multilevel_selection_experiment=scaffold_only. Phase H runs the ablation harness (messaging on vs off) as measurement. That still is not evolved language, not Avida C++, and not a major transition. This line is the primary literature map for how to get collective intelligence evidence: communication ablation, germline export-of-fitness, and cooperative networks that are discovered rather than tagged.
key_claims: Coordination instructions are evidence only if ablation drops group payoff.
Deme replicate-on-mean-fitness is multilevel selection only as a controlled experiment.
Germline/soma eligibility must be discovered, not assigned, to match GECCO 2008 / dirty-work results.
A contribution ledger is attribution, not causal proof of cooperation.
codontrace_has: Messaging buffer; role gates; Phase H communication-ablation harness; Phase I heldout/MLS analogs; Phase K evolved send/retrieve/broadcast instruction genomes on the Phase E buffer with ablation that can drop coordination payoff.
codontrace_lacks: Avida C++ ORGANISM_MESSAGING / DEME_GROUP; evolved language; evolved germline/soma networks.
next_experiment: How to get collective intelligence evidence: Phase K run_evolved_coordination_instruction_experiment at research scale; never set ClaimGate flags from smoke.

title: A Procedure for Testing for Tokyo Type 1 Open-Ended Evolution
summary: Channon 2024 specifies a *procedure* for testing Tokyo Type 1 open-ended evolution (Packard et al. 2019: Type 1 ≈ ongoing generation of adaptive novelty). The steps are measurement vocabulary: activity components (Bedau-style), evolutionary activity (novelty/diversity/cumulative series), adaptive novelty after a persistence filter, shadow/normalization, and multi-replicate aggregation. Completing the steps is not a pass. A shadow digest does not unlock a pass. Multi-seed campaigns do not unlock a pass. CodonTrace Genesis implements the step vocabulary (TokyoType1MeasurementProtocol, campaign seed_count>=2, opt-in Empirical-style shadow_digest) at ceiling tokyo_type1_measurement_only. ScientificClaimGate forbids tokyo_type1_passed, tokyo_type1_proved, channon_2024_passed, and aliases. CLIP/ASAL foundation-model open-ended search is out of core. Researchers who run every measurement step must still write 'Type 1 not passed'.
key_claims: Tokyo Type 1 is a test procedure, not a badge earned by implementing the steps.
Shadow/normalization and multi-replicate aggregation are required for a serious test and still insufficient for a pass without meeting the decision criterion.
Measurement-only labels must not be paraphrased as OEE proved or intelligence.
codontrace_has: TokyoType1MeasurementProtocol; Bedau/MODES inputs; persistence_window_t; multi-seed campaign; opt-in Python shuffled-parentage shadow adapter; ClaimGate block on pass aliases.
codontrace_lacks: A Type 1 pass. Empirical C++ systematics. Unbounded adaptive novelty as a result. Foundation-model OE search.
next_experiment: Long-horizon campaigns with real shadow phylogenies and pre-registered pass criteria — and keep the pass claim blocked until those criteria are actually met, which they are not.

title: Identifying Necessary Conditions for Open-Ended Evolution through the Artificial Life World of Chromaria
summary: Soros and Stanley used Chromaria to hypothesize four necessary conditions for open-ended evolution: (1) a nontrivial minimal criterion (MC) for reproduction that the seed itself must meet; (2) evolution of new individuals should create novel opportunities to satisfy the MC; (3) individuals decide how and where they interact with the world; (4) potential phenotypic size/complexity is in principle unbounded. Follow-up empirical work tests that removing a condition causes stagnation. An MC analog in a library (AliveGate, ATP birth gates) is not Chromaria condition 1 unless the seed must earn birth and the criterion is nontrivial. Condition 2 (self-generated opportunity landscapes) is the hardest and is not shown by researcher-scheduled resource fluctuations. Condition 3 is not satisfied by a tiny fixed action set on a 2D grid. Condition 4 is false of fixed codon-width instruction genomes. Passing a birth gate is not OEE.
key_claims: OEE requires a nontrivial MC that the seed meets, not a copy instruction.
New individuals must create new ways to satisfy the MC (self-generated opportunities).
Agent-directed interaction and unbounded phenotypic potential are necessary, not optional polish.
Controlled ablation of each condition is the Chromaria-grade test.
codontrace_has: AliveGate + runtime-ATP gates (MC analog); spatial eat/wait/copy; Phase C fluctuating environments; variable-genome tokens as a bounded complexity hook; Phase D MODES/Bedau after persistence.
codontrace_lacks: Chromaria-style knock-out tests of all four conditions; self-generated opportunity landscapes; unbounded phenotypic potential; agent-directed interaction at Chromaria depth.
next_experiment: Explicit four-condition ablation: disable MC / freeze opportunity landscape / restrict agency / bound phenotype, and test stagnation. Label oee_measurement_only. Do not claim OEE.

title: Open-endedness: The last grand challenge you’ve never heard of
summary: Stanley frames open-endedness as a necessary component of creative intelligence, not a metric checked once. The argument builds on Lehman and Stanley novelty search and the OEE workshop tradition: interesting novelty should keep being generated without a researcher-supplied final objective. A QD archive that fills bins, a MODES novelty number after a persistence window, or a Channon step that recorded activity are instruments. They are not creative intelligence. If a system has not got open-endedness as a *result*, it has not got that component of creative intelligence. CodonTrace Genesis has the instruments and an explicit refusal (open_ended_intelligence forbidden). Paraphrasing MODES novelty as creativity is a claim violation. The pathway from measurement to broader AI/OEE in Phase H is: keep building substrates and tests until open-ended generation of adaptive novelty is actually observed under controls — then still let ClaimGate decide, because observation of novelty is not AGI.
key_claims: Open-endedness is a component of creative intelligence, not a one-shot metric.
Researcher-supplied objectives are in tension with open-endedness.
Instrumentation without unbounded adaptive novelty is not the grand challenge solved.
codontrace_has: Novelty-aware QD archives; Bedau activity; persistence-filtered MODES; Channon measurement steps; ClaimGate block on open_ended_intelligence.
codontrace_lacks: Creative intelligence; a process that keeps generating adaptive novelty without a supplied objective and without bound.
next_experiment: Objective-free long-horizon runs scored only on ongoing adaptive novelty under shadow/normalization, still ClaimGate-blocked for intelligence.

title: Major evolutionary transitions and export-of-fitness (Szathmáry & Maynard Smith; Michod)
venue: Nature 374:227-232; Michod evolutionary transitions in individuality / Darwinian Dynamics
summary: Szathmáry and Maynard Smith (Nature 1995, doi:10.1038/374227a0) listed major evolutionary transitions: independent replicators becoming chromosomes, prokaryotes becoming eukaryotes, asexuals becoming sexuals, protists becoming multicellular organisms, solitary individuals becoming colonies, primate societies becoming human societies with language. Each transition creates a new level of individuality. Michod's export-of-fitness / evolutionary transitions in individuality (Darwinian Dynamics; PNAS 2007 104:8613-8618, doi:10.1073/pnas.0701482104) requires that fitness be exported to the higher-level unit and that lower-level conflict be suppressed (often via germline sequestration). A tagged deme whose mean fitness is recorded is not a new Darwinian individual. Rank-selecting demes is not conflict suppression. Round-robin soma/germline labels are not an evolved transition. Goldsby 2012's loss of lower-level autonomy under task-switching costs is the kind of *result* this literature demands. CodonTrace Genesis currently records group fitness and forbids collective_intelligence and major_transition_in_individuality.
key_claims: A major transition creates a new Darwinian individual, not a new data structure.
Export-of-fitness plus conflict suppression (often germline) are mechanistic requirements.
Group mean fitness without those mechanisms is group selection bookkeeping.
codontrace_has: Deme containers; germline/soma tags; replicate-on-mean-fitness; contribution ledger; Phase F/H group-vs-individual deltas; Phase I ExportOfFitnessObservation scaffold with major_transition_in_individuality=False.
codontrace_lacks: Evolved transition in individuality; endogenous conflict suppression and germline sequestration; Conlin-style unicell revertant fitness collapse that is not payoff construction.
next_experiment: Keep the Phase I export-of-fitness scaffold honest: do not set major_transition_in_individuality True until conflict suppression is endogenous.

title: JaxLife: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent in an Open-Ended World
summary: JaxLife (arXiv 2409.00853, 2024) deliberately abstracts physics/chemistry and uses embodied neural-network agents that seek culture and technology accumulation. That is a complementary cut to CodonTrace Genesis, which is instruction/genome ecology in the Avida tradition plus a first-class audit/replay/ClaimGate evidence layer. A JaxLife culture result is not a CodonTrace Genesis intelligence result. A CodonTrace Genesis digest is not a JaxLife embodiment result. ASAL / CLIP foundation-model open-ended search (arXiv 2412.17799) remains out of the dependency-free core. Phase H does not port JaxLife agents. Basal energy-budget inspiration is already landed on the life-loop preset. Complementary means cite, do not clone, and do not race.
key_claims: JaxLife abstracts physics/chemistry to study culture/tech in embodied NN agents.
Complementary systems must not steal each other's claims.
Foundation-model OE search is out of CodonTrace Genesis core on purpose.
codontrace_has: Avida-like instruction ecology; audit/replay/ClaimGate; basal energy-budget inspiration on life-loop; honesty docs naming JaxLife as complementary.
codontrace_lacks: Embodied NN agents; culture/tech accumulation; CLIP/ASAL OE search; physics-engine bodies.
next_experiment: Keep JaxLife and ASAL as documentation comparators. Optional out-of-core bridge later; never unlock avida_replacement or intelligence from a comparison table.

title: Beyond Fixed Representations: The Vocabulary and Verifier Gaps in Open-Ended AI
summary: Cao and Yang (arXiv 2607.09560, 2026) argue that modern AI mostly searches *inside* a fixed representational frame. Two gaps block open-ended intelligence: the vocabulary gap (inventing and stabilizing new primitives that change the search space, not merely recombining supplied tokens) and the verifier gap (judging a new primitive when payoff is visible only after future reuse, possibly requiring the evaluator to co-evolve). Intra-space transformations are not generative ones. CodonTrace Genesis supplies an instruction/codon vocabulary; ADF/macro proposals extend the table as auditable metadata; contribution ledgers attribute local reward; ClaimGate is an *external* verifier that refuses overclaim. Those are intra-space operations until a primitive changes what can be expressed *and* a downstream evaluator prefers it for reasons the current fitness function cannot yet state. That has not happened. ClaimGate staying strict is aligned with the verifier gap: weakening the gate to unlock intelligence would fake the verifier, not close the gap.
key_claims: Vocabulary gap: new primitives must change the search frame and stabilize through reuse.
Verifier gap: payoff may be invisible until future reuse; the evaluator may need to change.
External claim gates are not co-evolving verifiers, but they must not be weakened to simulate one.
codontrace_has: Instruction/codon vocabulary; ADF/macro proposal objects; contribution ledger; delayed-reward traces; ClaimGate as external overclaim refusal.
codontrace_lacks: Endogenous vocabulary that alters the search frame because it pays; a verifier that co-evolves; future-reuse credit beyond attribution estimates.
next_experiment: Track ADF macros that are reused in later generations under ablation of the macro table; still do not auto-pass open_ended_intelligence. Keep ClaimGate honest.

title: Role Differentiation in a Coupled Resource Ecology under Multi-Level Selection
summary: Chaturvedi, El-Gazzar, and van Gerven (arXiv 2604.00810, 2026) show that multilevel selection can maintain role differentiation in a common-pool ecology and avoid collapse into a single resource channel (tragedy of the commons). Agents share a controller substrate and mutation operator shaped by group-level selection while individuals still compete. Two coupled channels — positive-sum intake (grazing) and zero-sum redistribution (exchange) — stay occupied at colony level. Roles are dynamic: individuals switch over a lifetime while the group keeps a stable mix. Ablations suggest inherited behavioral basis carries most performance; learned variation adds a smaller systematic gain. This is a 2026 computational MLS result CodonTrace Genesis does *not* replicate. Assigned round-robin roles are the opposite of dynamic coupled-channel differentiation. Phase H group-vs-individual campaigns with effect sizes are the measurement on-ramp, not the paper. Collective intelligence remains blocked.
key_claims: MLS can sustain differentiated use of coupled resource channels under individual competition.
Roles need not be castes; dynamic switching with stable group mix is a result, not a tag.
Ablate group-level selection before claiming the mechanism.
codontrace_has: Deme/group containers; Phase H effect-size fields; Phase I MLS vs organism-only evolutionary *outcome* analog (majority strategy), not only a fitness delta.
codontrace_lacks: Coupled positive-sum/zero-sum channels; shared controller/mutation operator under MLS; tragedy-of-the-commons ecology as in the paper.
next_experiment: Two-channel resource ecology remains future work. Phase I MLS outcome harness is the current measurement on-ramp. Claim ceiling runtime_observation.

title: Division of labor promotes the entrenchment of multicellularity
summary: Conlin, Goldsby, Libby, Skocelas, Ratcliff, Ofria, and Kerr (bioRxiv 2023.03.15.532780) show that reproductive division of labor promotes the *entrenchment* of multicellularity in Avida. Simple multicellular groups evolve readily but revert; subsequent mutations that differentiate germ and soma make unicellular revertants unfit because unicells cannot circumvent a metabolic-productivity vs information-fidelity trade-off. When DoL is disincentivized, entrenchment does not increase. Related AvidaMT software implements tissue accretion vs propagule production as distinct instructions. This is the Avida multicellularity/DoL line Phase H must cite beside Goldsby 2012: DoL is not only an efficiency trick, it can lock in a higher-level individual. CodonTrace Genesis has germline/soma *tags* and DoL *metrics*, not tissue accretion, not revertant assays, not entrenchment curves. major_transition_in_individuality stays False. Entrenchment assays are part of the collective-intelligence / major-transition evidence path, not a fitness-mean table. Phase K run_revertant_isolation_assay is a hook, not that AvidaMT assay.
key_claims: DoL can entrench multicellularity by making unicellular revertants unfit.
Germ-soma differentiation plus a metabolic/fidelity trade-off is a mechanistic path.
Disincentivizing DoL blocks entrenchment — a required control.
codontrace_has: Role/germline/soma tags; DoL metrics; Phase K revertant isolation assay hook (entrenchment_of_multicellularity=False; isolation collapse in the preference analog remains payoff construction).
codontrace_lacks: Tissue accretion vs propagule production; unicell revertant fitness assays that are not payoff construction; entrenchment-over-time curves; endogenous germ-soma DoL.
next_experiment: How to get collective intelligence evidence: keep Phase K revertant hooks honest; still not a major-transition claim without endogenous differentiation.

title: Normalized mutual entropy in biology: quantifying diversity and division of labor
summary: Gorelick, Bertram, Killeen, and Fewell (Integrative and Comparative Biology 2004, doi:10.1093/icb/44.5.345) treat normalized mutual information / mutual entropy between individuals and tasks as a general DoL statistic. Goldsby et al. PNAS 2012 used this family of measures. A single snapshot where each organism appears once inflates mutual information; a lifetime of task choices is required so generalists (mixed tasks) score lower than consistent specialists. CodonTrace Genesis Phase I computes an analog on evolved two-task preferences. That analog is not bit-identical to the paper and is not a Goldsby 50-replicate result. Assigned round-robin role tags are not this statistic.
key_claims: DoL should be measured as information between identities and tasks, not as a role-tag count.
Repeated observations per individual are required; one-shot unique IDs make NMI trivially 1 whenever tasks differ.
A DoL number is not collective intelligence.
codontrace_has: Phase I gorelick_normalized_mutual_information on lifetime task samples from an evolved preference gene.
codontrace_lacks: Bit-identical Gorelick NMI on Avida task-export traces; 50-replicate campaigns as default evidence.
next_experiment: Keep NMI as a measurement on evolved (not assigned) task choices; pair with ablation of specialization. Claim ceiling runtime_observation.

title: Evolution and the Levels of Selection
summary: Okasha (2006) distinguishes MLS1 (group fitness as mean particle fitness; often a fitness-accounting / Price partition) from MLS2 (the group as a Darwinian individual whose evolutionary *outcome* can differ from particle-only selection). A rank table of deme mean fitness, or a group-vs-individual fitness delta, can be MLS1 bookkeeping without showing that a different strategy or lineage wins. CodonTrace Genesis Phase F ranking is observational. Phase H effect-size campaigns record Cohen's d on group fitness. Phase I run_mls_evolutionary_outcome_experiment compares majority strategy under group replacement vs organism-only selection. Phase J run_price_equation_covariance_scaffold records last-generation between/within covariance terms on that analog. Phase K adds a multi-generation transmission term. That is still not a full Price-equation paper and not collective intelligence.
key_claims: MLS1 fitness accounting is not the same as MLS2 evolutionary outcome.
A group-vs-individual delta can be bookkeeping; the question is which strategy wins.
Multilevel selection is an experiment, not a rank table.
codontrace_has: Phase I MLS vs organism-only outcome labels; Phase J Price snapshot; Phase K multi-generation Price with a transmission term on the two-task analog.
codontrace_lacks: A published Price paper; Avida DEME_GROUP MLS2 at literature scale.
next_experiment: How to get collective intelligence evidence: keep Price terms as bookkeeping; require Phase J independent digest replay at research scale for replay_verification; never auto-set flags from smoke.

title: Evolution of individuality during the transition from unicellular to multicellular life
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences 104:8613-8618
summary: Michod (PNAS 2007, doi:10.1073/pnas.0701482104) frames evolutionary transitions in individuality as export-of-fitness to a higher-level unit plus conflict suppression (often germline sequestration). Group mean fitness without those mechanisms is bookkeeping. Isolation/revertant collapse is evidence only when lower-level autonomy was actually lost, not when the payoff function forbids singletons from scoring. CodonTrace Genesis Phase I ExportOfFitnessObservation records isolation vs group competence, marks isolation collapse as payoff construction in the two-task analog, keeps conflict_suppression_endogenous and germline_sequestration_endogenous False, and refuses major_transition_in_individuality=True on that scaffold. Phase K adds measurement hooks for within-group conflict and cheater/revertant assays; conflict_suppression_endogenous stays False.
key_claims: Export-of-fitness plus conflict suppression are mechanistic requirements for a new Darwinian individual.
Payoff functions that give groups a score singletons cannot earn are not by themselves a transition.
major_transition_in_individuality must stay false until the mechanisms are endogenous.
codontrace_has: Phase I ExportOfFitnessObservation scaffold; Phase K ConflictSuppressionObservation hooks (within-group variance, cheater invasion, revertant isolation) with endogenous and major-transition flags False.
codontrace_lacks: Endogenous conflict suppression; evolved germline sequestration; Conlin-style revertant assays that are not payoff construction.

title: Selection and covariance
summary: Price (1970, Nature doi:10.1038/227520a0) showed that selection on a trait is a covariance between that trait and fitness. Okasha (2006) uses the hierarchical (between-group + within-group) form as MLS1 bookkeeping. A covariance snapshot is not MLS2 evolutionary outcome, not a major transition, and not collective intelligence. CodonTrace Genesis Phase J run_price_equation_covariance_scaffold records last-generation between/within/total covariance on the two-task analog, checks the MLS1 partition identity, and leaves the transmission term unestimated. Phase K estimates a transmission term from realized parent–offspring preference change after mutation and still sets price_equation_complete=False. major_transition_in_individuality stays False. How to get collective intelligence evidence: keep Price terms as measurement and attach independent digest replay at research scale so replay_verification can be earned honestly.
key_claims: Selection on a trait is covariance with fitness, not a slogan.
Between-group plus within-group terms are MLS1 bookkeeping; MLS2 asks which strategy wins.
A covariance number is not collective intelligence.
codontrace_has: Phase J Price snapshot partition (MLS1 identity) plus Phase K run_multi_generation_price_analysis with a realized parent–offspring transmission term. price_equation_complete stays False.
codontrace_lacks: A published multi-generation Price paper; Avida DEME_GROUP MLS2; empirical covariance tables.
next_experiment: How to get collective intelligence evidence: keep Price terms as measurement; do not set price_equation_complete from an analog residual. Claim ceiling runtime_observation.

title: Extension of covariance selection mathematics
summary: Price (1972, Annals of Human Genetics doi:10.1111/j.1469-1809.1972.tb00796.x) extends the 1970 covariance selection identity to include a transmission / change-in-character term. The discrete form used in multilevel bookkeeping is Δz̄ = Cov(w, z)/w̄ + E[w Δz]/w̄. The second term is not optional decoration: without it the identity does not account for mutation, imperfect inheritance, or other parent–offspring change. A last-generation covariance snapshot (Phase J) is incomplete as a Price analysis. CodonTrace Genesis Phase K run_multi_generation_price_analysis estimates transmission from realized parent–offspring preference change after mutation on the two-task analog, checks a residual, and still sets price_equation_complete=False. That is analog bookkeeping, not this paper.
key_claims: The selection-as-covariance identity is completed by a transmission term.
Truncation-plus-mutation on a toy trait can estimate a transmission number; that is not a Price 1972 empirical result.
A transmission number is not collective intelligence and not a major transition.
codontrace_has: Phase K multi-generation Price scaffold with transmission_term_estimated=True and an attached Phase J last-generation MLS1 snapshot.
codontrace_lacks: A published multi-generation Price paper; Avida DEME_GROUP MLS2; empirical covariance tables.
next_experiment: How to get collective intelligence evidence: keep Price terms as measurement; do not set price_equation_complete from an analog residual. Claim ceiling runtime_observation.
